result_text:
I can't run the new command here: the sandbox blocks running it with a computed classpath. I did get `mvn -q -o -pl cli compile` to pass.

I added `analyzeLandscape` as an alias of `updateLandscape`. Nothing has been run or tested beyond the compile. That means I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` creates `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`, or that `-help` prints the right usage. I didn't run the cli module's tests either.

- **`Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION` constants. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also in the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run()` sends both names to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so the options and behaviour are identical. `-help` prints the usage and description of whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Commands" section. It describes `analyzeLandscape` as the documented name and `updateLandscape` as the older name kept for existing scripts.
